content.comment_body: Dear [product_name] community, is it possible to use the [product_name] Communication Interface Module as an internet router or only for AWS access with the [product_name] Basis Module? For example, can you access another ([product_name] Basis Module + [product_name] Communication Interface Module) or use the Web Editor from the [product_name] Basis Module? Also, regarding the Mobile Communication Module, can it serve as an internet router for a [product_name] Basis Module?

Hello, No, you cannot use the Communication Interface Module as an internet router. Only time and date synchronization and AWS connectivity are supported continuously; other connections are not possible. Hope this information is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are interested in using the Communication Interface Module and Mobile Communication Module as internet routers to enable broader connectivity. However, current device capabilities are limited to time/date synchronization and AWS connectivity, restricting general-purpose internet routing and device-to-device access. This limitation affects overall network flexibility and integration for these modules.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate that the Communication Interface Module and Mobile Communication Module would support internet routing or offer more networking flexibility to facilitate both device and cloud (like AWS) access.
